preview_mean_scan_path_ratio.Description: Mean across the participant's preview trials of the scan path ratio: total distance travelled between successive fixations divided by the straight-line distance from the display centre to the face centroid; 1 means the gaze went straight to the face.

no_preview_mean_scan_path_ratio.Description: Mean across the participant's no-preview trials of the scan path ratio: total distance travelled between successive fixations divided by the straight-line distance from the display centre to the face centroid; 1 means the gaze went straight to the face.
